verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an extensive documented public JS/TS API (Scenes, GameObjects, Loader, Physics, Animations, full TypeScript definitions) that any code-driven agent can call programmatically, which functionally covers 'driving the product via a documented API' for a game framework. However, probes show no machine-readable API spec (llms.txt 404, openapi.json 404, docs-as-markdown 404), meaning AI agents must parse human-oriented docs rather than a structured API contract. Missing for 10: machine-readable/OpenAPI-style API spec, llms.txt for AI consumption, independent confirmation that agents successfully drive the raw API (only the separate MCP tool layer is agent-oriented).
